title: Pictures never change a gate
statement: Keep pictures out of every reading and question gate, so adding art never changes a page's pacing or reveals a question early, and recheck the gates after any art change.
example: When art was added to forty-five reading pages, none of it entered the reading-gate calculation.
detail: Research before atmospheric art was added to the rebuilt lessons found that a teaching page with an illustration but no passage skipped the read-before-question hold, so adding art could change a student's pacing or reveal questions early. The plan made art placement answer to the existing gates and listed artwork that changes reading or assessment gates as a failure to detect with source diffs and reading and why-check tests. In the delivered build, art went onto forty-five reading pages and no artwork entered the reading-gate calculation.

evidence.quote: Check gate behavior when adding art. `core.tsx:552–566` makes an illustrated text/frame teaching page without passage skip the reading-before-question hold. Passage/verse questions retain it. `BookLesson.tsx:289` uses this result to lock progress. A decorative asset must not accidentally change student pacing or reveal questions early.
Art placement must not suppress checkHeldBy.
F1 - Artwork changes reading or assessment gates
Detect with source diff and reading/why-check tests.
Forty-five pure passage pages use an illustrated book spread. Practice keeps the source text beside the task. Verse lineation stays intact. No artwork enters the reading-gate calculation.
